verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents a few narrow bulk actions of its own: a 'Publish draft policies' action that publishes every draft not requiring review in one step, and a one-click secure baseline that pre-fills organization-wide device policy across macOS and Windows. Removing a framework also cascades to remove its unused auto-added controls. There is no general multi-select or batch capability across findings, controls, or other items, and the MCP server and service keys are only building blocks with no documented batch tools. Missing for 10: general bulk select/edit/assign/resolve across findings, controls or evidence; documented bulk actions via MCP or API; any independent or hands-on corroboration.
